Who I Am

Builder. Designer. Coordinator.

I'm a BIM Designer and Coordinator based in Greenville, SC, with a background spanning architectural engineering, construction engineering, and project operations. I've worked across commercial, municipal, and industrial projects — developing detailed models, coordinating multi-discipline teams, and delivering work on time and under budget.

My career started with hands-on construction experience before evolving into BIM leadership roles at engineering firms like Garver and Bailey & Sons. Today, I also bring operational and data analysis skills honed as an Operations Specialist, tracking labor trends and driving cost savings.

I'm bilingual in English and Spanish, hold professional certificates in Revit and AutoCAD, and am currently pursuing a Bachelor's in Business Management at Western Governors University to complement my engineering foundation.
